title: Detailed cherries
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='cherry1' cx='35%' cy='30%' r='65%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff6b7a'/>
      <stop offset='35%' stop-color='#e8192c'/>
      <stop offset='75%' stop-color='#b8001a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#7a0010'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='cherry2' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='65%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff8088'/>
      <stop offset='30%' stop-color='#e02030'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#a80018'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#6e000e'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='highlight' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffdde0' stop-opacity='0.85'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffdde0' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='stemGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7ec850'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#4a8a2a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='leafGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#9be05a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#3d7a1a'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- stems -->
  <path d='M50 38 Q48 25 42 18' stroke='#5a9e30' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M52 38 Q56 26 60 20' stroke='#5a9e30' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M42 18 Q50 12 60 20' stroke='#4a8a2a' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- leaf -->
  <path d='M60 20 Q72 10 82 14 Q80 24 68 26 Q62 24 60 20Z' fill='url(#leafGrad)' stroke='#2e5c10' stroke-width='1'/>
  <path d='M62 21 Q72 16 79 16' stroke='#2e5c10' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/>

  <!-- cherry 1, lower left -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='62' r='20' fill='url(#cherry1)'/>
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='54' rx='7' ry='5' fill='url(#highlight)' transform='rotate(-30 28 54)'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='62' r='20' fill='none' stroke='#ff6677' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='80' rx='12' ry='4' fill='#8a0012' opacity='0.45'/>

  <!-- cherry 2, lower right -->
  <circle cx='64' cy='64' r='19' fill='url(#cherry2)'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='56' rx='6' ry='4.5' fill='url(#highlight)' transform='rotate(-25 59 56)'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='64' r='19' fill='none' stroke='#ff7788' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='81' rx='11' ry='3.5' fill='#7a000e' opacity='0.45'/>

  <!-- stem connection dimples -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='43' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#a00018'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='46' rx='3.5' ry='2.2' fill='#90001a'/>

  <!-- tiny shine dots -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='50' r='1.8' fill='#fff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='52' r='1.5' fill='#fff' opacity='0.85'/>
</svg>
